row.evidence: Front's pricing page lists "Multiple workspaces, SSO, and SCIM" on Professional ($65/seat/mo billed annually), not on Starter ($25), and the help centre says SCIM provisioning "is available on the latest Professional plan or above."
row.notes: Plans changed since June: the Starter ($19) / Growth ($59) / Scale ($99) / Premier lineup is now Starter $25 (up to 10 seats), Professional $65 (up to 50 seats) and Enterprise $105 per seat/mo billed annually (monthly: Starter $35, Professional $85; Enterprise annual only). SAML SSO and SCIM moved from Scale ($99) down to Professional ($65), so the multiplier drops from 5.2x to 2.6x; status stays gated (SCIM is one tier above the team plan). SCIM 2.0 base https://scim.frontapp.com/v2 with an admin-created API token (Auto-provisioning feature). Okta, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue apps and Google Workspace autoprovisioning; Entra uses a non-gallery app. Okta/Entra deprovisioning blocks (soft-deletes) the teammate and frees the licence; reactivation unblocks. Core API on all plans (Starter 50 rpm).

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: $25/seat/mo billed annually, up to 10 seats ($35 monthly)

plans.name: Professional
plans.price_text: $65/seat/mo billed annually, up to 50 seats ($85 monthly)

auth.token_source: Settings > Developers > API Tokens > Create API token, Feature access: Auto-provisioning (admin only)

deprovision.data_retained: Teammate is Blocked (soft delete, reversible); history stays visible and assigned shared-inbox conversations are unassigned. Okta and Entra cannot hard-delete via the integration.

custom.how: Teammate custom fields via urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:frontapp:teammate_custom_fields:{field_id}; teammate preset via urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:frontapp:teammate:template

roles.how: Teammate preset (template) chosen at creation via roles[type=template] (Okta) or the frontapp teammate:template extension mapped from Entra app roles; presets apply only at creation.

limitations.text: Okta and Microsoft Entra ID cannot delete users via the integration; users are blocked even when deleted in the IdP.
IdP-managed teammate groups cannot be renamed, edited or deleted inside Front or via the Core API.
Teammate presets apply only at creation; userName must equal the Okta primary email.
Entra requires the aadOptscim062020 tenant URL flag and Entra ID P1/P2; Entra provisioning runs every 40 minutes by default.
The developer docs describe the Auto-provisioning SCIM token as "not generally available to the public", while the help centre documents it for all Professional+ customers.

endpoints.purpose: Update teammate (username, names, availability, custom fields)

audit_log_api.notes: An in-app audit log with export exists; no audit-log API endpoint found in the Core API index.

rate_limits.text: Per company: Starter 50 rpm, Professional 100 rpm, Enterprise 200 rpm; add-on $200 per 100 rpm/month; OAuth partner integrations 120 rpm.

limitations.text: No create, invite, block or delete teammate endpoint is documented in the Core API; lifecycle goes through SCIM or the admin UI.

okta.notes: OIN page (rendered) checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial is SSO-only; Front documents SCIM through a non-gallery Entra app pointed at the generic endpoint.

google.notes: Google autoprovisioning supports suspend and hard delete; Front lists Google Workspace as provisioning only (no group sync).

onelogin.notes: Front's IdP table lists OneLogin for provisioning, presets and group sync; OneLogin's own catalogue page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Rippling and Gusto user provisioning (per Front IdP table)

conflicts.text: Front's developer docs call the SCIM Auto-provisioning token "not generally available to the public"; the help centre documents the public base URL for any Professional+ customer.
Okta and Entra guides say deletion is not possible via the integration, while JumpCloud and Google say their Front apps can delete teammates.

open_questions: Front docs do not say whether SCIM DELETE hard-deletes or blocks a teammate.
SCIM filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented (ServiceProviderConfig needs a token).
Whether SAML JIT creates teammates is not documented.
Whether the in-app audit log is exposed via API is not documented.
Plan availability of Admin audit logs is shown only as icons on the pricing page.
